source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 by an exact SAT model of an array invariant under a column group. Columns 0 to 16 are the residues modulo 17; the group generated by x -> x+1 and x -> 9x (the cyclic group Z17 and the multiplier subgroup of order 8 of GF(17)*) acts on them, and column 17 is fixed. The rows are 4 constant rows and the orbits of 7 words with stabilizers of orders 2, 2, 4, 4, 8, 8 and 8 (orbit sizes 68, 68, 34, 34, 17, 17 and 17, 255 rows). The free bits of the words were decided by CaDiCaL 1.5.3 through python-sat 1.9.dev22 with one clause per orbit of a (6-set, pattern) pair, column complements and lex order between equal-stabilizer words as symmetry breaking (programs/eager.py, arguments 8 100000 2 2 4 4 8 8 8, deterministic, 23 s). programs/recipe.sh runs it; a run from scratch reproduced the array exactly (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 6-sets
construction: Column-orbit array under Z17 with a multiplier subgroup of order 8 and one fixed column, 7 word orbits and 4 constant rows, words found by exact SAT
notes: one row below the cited size 260 at k = 18; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
